key_insight: CuAD transforms CUDA kernels into tangent and adjoint CUDA source, enabling accurate GPU-based sensitivities for aerodynamic simulation.
engineering_relevance: Generated derivatives support aerodynamic shape optimization and data assimilation while avoiding the gradient errors introduced by finite-difference Jacobians.
method: Generate tangent and adjoint kernels through source-to-source automatic differentiation.
Organize reverse mode around GPU threads, recomputing intermediates and differentiating pure accumulations without a tape.
Assume non-aliasing inputs and outputs; store remaining tape in fixed thread-local arrays.
evidence_signal: Across four flow-model kernels and a 2D Euler solver, derivatives passed dot-product tests to round-off, adjoints cost 2–6× primal kernels, and transonic NACA 0012 adjoint sensitivities agreed with tangents to 10⁻¹³.
watch_item: Use requires respecting the non-aliasing convention; fixed thread-local tape capacity and performance should be checked for larger or more complex kernels.
paper_title: CuAD: Source-to-Source Automatic Differentiation of CUDA Kernels for Discrete Adjoints in Computational Fluid Dynamics
